newsitem.title: UK: BA details UK operational impact of strike.
newsitem.headline: BA details UK operational impact of strike.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Wednesday that industrial action by members of the British Airlines' Stewards and Stewardesses Association (BASSA) has forced the cancellation of 135 BA flights from Heathrow and nine from Gatwick.
The operational details are as follows:
Total schedule -- 135 (69 percent) cancelled out of 196.
Shorthaul European -- 62 (62 percent) cancelled out of 100.
UK domestic -- 46 (100 percent) cancelled out of 46.
Total schedule -- nine (eight percent) cancelled out of 93.
Longhaul -- nine (56 percent) cancelled out of 16.
Shorthaul European -- nil cancelled out of 56.
UK domestic -- nil cancelled out of 21.
BA said in a statement that it would usually fly around 40,000 customers out of Heathrow. Today it will carry some 14,000, about 35 percent of normal.
It would normally fly around 15,000 out of Gatwick, but today that number would be reduced to about 13,800, some 90 percent of normal.
